EightState Studios appointed Elisa Richardson as chief communications officer and Chip Singh as ECD.

Ernesta hired Rohit Bagalkot as VP of marketing and Kelly Shah as director of inventory planning.

GetResponse welcomed Michael Leslie as chief technology officer.

George P. Johnson (GPJ) promoted Brian Neville to global COO and Paolo Zeppa to president of GPJ Americas.

Goliath promoted Angela Truhan to VP of global brand marketing and named Liz Grampp VP of North American marketing. [...] Merge announced its acquisition of Brado’sinsight and digital practices.

Odyssey Entertainment Group (OEG) launched Odyssey Originals, a creator studio that aims to help creators develop and publish original content while retaining full ownership of their work.
